# [TASK] Kafka broker + facade save-through event publishing

## Task
Stand up a local Kafka broker and have movie-service publish an event on
every TMDB facade save-through — first half of the Kafka epic (#39, via
Story #96).

- Add a single-node Kafka broker (KRaft mode, no ZooKeeper) to
  `infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml`, plus a manifest for the
  local K8s overlay (`infrastructure/kubernetes/overlays`) — local
  profiles only, per ADR-006's free-tier constraint.
- Add `spring-kafka` to movie-service.
- Publish a `tmdb.document.saved` event from `TmdbFacadeController` (the
  actual save-through class — there is no separate `TmdbFacadeService`)
  after each save: key is the canonical request key, payload is endpoint
  type / path / timestamp only, not the full document body.
- Publishing is async and fire-and-forget: a broker outage must never fail
  or slow down the request path — log and swallow.

## Parent Story
Parent: #96

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Kafka broker runs via `docker-compose.yml` (local K8s overlay
      manifest included) — no cloud/production profile changes
- [x] `spring-kafka` added to movie-service and a producer configured for
      the `tmdb.document.saved` topic
- [x] `TmdbFacadeController` publishes on every save-through with the
      metadata-only payload described above
- [x] Testcontainers Kafka integration test proves both: the event is
      published on save, and a broker-down scenario doesn't fail the
      request
- [x] Full Javadoc on all new/changed classes and methods per CLAUDE.md
